title: Module Review Quiz: Advanced Functional Programming

slides.title: Module Overview: Advanced Functional Programming
slides.prompt: This Module Review Quiz tests your knowledge on higher-order functions, partial application, currying, pure functions, and generator expressions.
slides.codeSnippet:
from functools import partial
def mul(a, b): return a * b
double = partial(mul, 2)
print(double(10)) # 20

slides.title: Partial Application Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the module required to construct partial functions.

slides.title: Pure Function Properties
slides.prompt: Which condition is essential for a function to be considered pure?
options: It returns the same output for identical inputs with zero side effects
It must use a lambda expression internally
It modifies global scope variables directly
slides.correctAnswer: It returns the same output for identical inputs with zero side effects
